learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to analyze and calculate energy conversion processes using the first and second laws of thermodynamics.
Students understand the behavior of single-component systems and can explain and evaluate thermodynamic processes using state diagrams and process schematics.
Students can independently describe the basic thermodynamic terms and reproduce the essential working methods of thermodynamics.

Students are able, within the framework of the exercise, to independently apply the methods covered in the lecture and to thermodynamically analyze technical questions, develop solutions, and work out the solution.

syllabus_topics: State variables and equations of state of ideal gas
Energy and first law for closed systems
assessment_rules: The assessment is a written examination lasting 165 minutes. This examination accounts for 100% of the module grade.
